transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got a held shipment of 600 drums of moisture-sensitive polyurethane adhesive that came in this morning — receiving flagged it on a temperature alarm. Friday's production schedule is going to need adhesive from this shipment or an approved replacement, so we need to work through this hold efficiently. Before I make a disposition decision, I need to hear from each area: Quality, do you have any findings on the temperature excursion? Maintenance, anything relevant on the alarm condition itself? Logistics, what's our staging and replacement options look like? And EHS, any concerns on this material? Let's get into it.

I have not yet entered this result in the warehouse hold record, but I'm doing so now so it's officially documented.
